# Where Does Your Charity Donation REALLY Go? The Shocking Truth About Overhead **You donate $100 to a major charity organization. How much reaches the actual people in need?** If you think it's $100, **you're wrong.** And the charity industry doesn't want you to know this. --- ## 💰 The Overhead Reality: Where Your $100 Goes
| **Organization Type** | **Your $100 Donation** | **Actual Impact** | **Goes to Overhead** | |-----------------------|------------------------|-------------------|----------------------| | 🏢 **Large Charity Organizations** | $100 | $60-85 | $15-40 (admin, CEO salaries, marketing) | | 🏦 **International NGOs** | $100 | $70-80 | $20-30 (bureaucracy, offices, staff) | | 🎗️ **Fundraising Platforms (GoFundMe)** | $100 | $92-95 | $5-8 (platform fees, payment processing) | | ✅ **AbleHearts (Direct Giving)** | $100 | **$100** | **$0 (100% to Mary & Lydia)** |
**The harsh truth:** Most charity organizations keep 15-40% of your donation before it ever reaches the people you're trying to help. --- ## 🤯 What "Overhead" Actually Means (And Why Organizations Hide It) ### The Polite Term: "Administrative Costs" Charity organizations call it "overhead" or "administrative costs." Here's what that really means: **CEO & Executive Salaries:** - 💼 Red Cross CEO: **$694,000/year** (2021) - 💼 United Way CEO: **$1.2 million/year** (2019) - 💼 Goodwill CEO: **$712,000/year** (average) - 💼 Salvation Army Commissioner: **$155,000/year** (modest for charity) **Marketing & Fundraising:** - 📺 TV commercials showing sad children - 📧 Aggressive email campaigns - 📬 Direct mail solicitations - 🎉 Gala fundraising events (which cost money to host) **Office Rent & Facilities:** - 🏢 Downtown offices in expensive cities - 🚗 Company vehicles for executives - ✈️ International travel for "site visits" **Bureaucracy:** - 📝 Compliance officers - 💼 Legal teams - 📊 Accountants & auditors - 👥 HR departments **Is it all bad?** No. Some overhead is necessary. But **15-40% is excessive** when real people are dying from lack of resources. --- ## 😠 The Industry Secret: Why They Don't Want You Asking ### "Don't Focus on Overhead - Focus on Impact!" You'll hear charity watchdogs say: *"Overhead doesn't matter - it's about impact!"* **Translation:** *"Please don't look too closely at where your money goes."* **The uncomfortable truth:** - 🏦 If a charity spends 30% on overhead, that's $30 of your $100 going to salaries and rent - not to the disabled woman who needs a wheelchair - 💔 That $30 could have bought a month of food for Mary and Lydia - ⚠️ Organizations with higher overhead often have LESS impact per dollar ### The Deceptive Accounting Tricks Some charities use creative accounting to hide overhead: 1. **"Program expenses" that aren't really programs:** - Fundraising mailings labeled as "education" - Awareness campaigns that are really marketing - "Administrative" staff reclassified as "program" staff 2. **The 80/20 illusion:** - "80% goes to programs!" sounds great - But "programs" includes staff salaries, office rent for "program" teams - Actual cash/goods to beneficiaries? Often only 50-60% 3. **Delayed recognition:** - Donations this year spent on "infrastructure" - Impact (maybe) next year - Your $100 sits in their bank account earning them interest --- ## 🎯 Why Direct Giving Beats Organizations ### AbleHearts vs. Traditional Charity Model
| **Factor** | **🏢 Traditional Charity** | **✅ AbleHearts (Direct Giving)** | |------------|----------------------------|-----------------------------------| | **Your $100 goes to:** | $60-85 to beneficiaries | **$100 to Mary & Lydia** | | **Overhead:** | 15-40% | **0%** | | **CEO Salary:** | $155,000 - $1.2 million | **$0 (volunteer-run)** | | **Office Rent:** | Expensive downtown offices | **$0 (online only)** | | **Marketing Spend:** | Millions on TV ads | **$0 (social media, word of mouth)** | | **Transparency:** | Annual reports (vague) | **Real-time updates, photos, receipts** | | **You know the person:** | Faceless "beneficiary #4,281" | **Mary & Lydia (names, faces, stories)** | | **Updates:** | Quarterly newsletter | **Direct WhatsApp updates, photos** | | **Impact speed:** | 6-12 months to deploy | **Immediate (days to weeks)** |
### Real Example: Your $500 Donation **Traditional Charity Route:** - $500 donation - -$75 (15% overhead): CEO salary, office rent, staff - -$50 (10% fundraising): marketing to get more donors - -$25 (5% admin): compliance, legal, accounting - **$350 reaches Kenya** (after months of processing) - -$50 (local partner NGO fees): their overhead too - **$300 actual impact** (if you're lucky) **AbleHearts Direct Route:** - $500 donation via PayPal/crypto/bank transfer - -$0 overhead - **$500 reaches Mary & Lydia** (within days) - **$500 actual impact:** Wheelchair, medical care, food, education **You just gave 66% MORE impact** by choosing direct giving. --- ## 🚨 The Charity Industry Doesn't Want You to Know ### Fact #1: Most Charities Are Businesses **They have:** - 💼 Executives making 6-figure salaries - 🏢 Real estate holdings - 💰 Investment portfolios - 📈 Growth targets (more donations = bigger bonuses) **They operate like corporations** - but with tax-exempt status and your goodwill. ### Fact #2: The "Impact" Is Often Exaggerated **Marketing claims:** - 🎗️ "We helped 1 million people!" - 📊 "Your donation builds wells in Africa!" **Reality:** - 👥 "Helped" = sent a pamphlet, not actual aid - 💧 The well costs $5,000, but they spent $20,000 raising that $5,000 - 📸 The photos are from 3 years ago - 🔍 No way to verify if it actually happened ### Fact #3: There's a Better Way **Direct giving platforms exist NOW:** - ✅ **AbleHearts**: 100% to Mary & Lydia, zero overhead - ✅ **GiveDirectly**: Cash transfers to extreme poor (3-5% overhead, transparent) - ✅ **Kiva**: Micro-loans to individuals (20% overhead for infrastructure, but you choose the person) **You don't need big organizations.** Technology allows you to help real people directly. --- ## 💡 How to Evaluate Any Charity (Before Donating) ### The 5 Questions Every Philanthropist Should Ask **1. What percentage goes to overhead?** - ✅ Under 10%: Excellent - ⚠️ 10-20%: Acceptable - 🚨 20-30%: High (question if necessary) - ❌ 30%+: Excessive (avoid) **2. What does "program expenses" actually include?** - Ask for a detailed breakdown - Watch for inflated salaries labeled as "programs" **3. Can I see proof of impact?** - Photos with dates - Receipts - Testimonials from actual beneficiaries **4. How long until my donation creates impact?** - ✅ Days to weeks: Efficient - ⚠️ Months: Bureaucratic - 🚨 "We're building infrastructure": Your $ sits unused **5. Do I know the person I'm helping?** - ✅ Yes (name, face, story): True connection - ❌ No (just "beneficiaries in Africa"): Impersonal, unverifiable ### Red Flags 🚩 - ❌ **Won't disclose overhead percentage** - ❌ **CEO makes more than $200k** - ❌ **Aggressive fundraising tactics** (guilt, urgency, emotional manipulation) - ❌ **Vague impact reports** ("helped thousands!") - ❌ **Can't provide receipts or photos** - ❌ **No direct contact with beneficiaries** --- ## 🌟 The AbleHearts Promise: 100% Transparency, Zero Overhead ### Why We're Different **1. Real-Time Updates:** - 📸 Photos of purchases (wheelchair, food, medical care) - 📝 Receipts showing exactly what we bought - 💬 WhatsApp updates directly from Mary & Lydia - 🎥 Video testimonials **4. You Choose What to Fund:** - 🛒 Browse our wishlist: wheelchair, orthopedic shoes, food, education - 💰 Or donate for their most urgent need - 📊 See exactly how your $ was spent **5. Tax-Deductible (USA, Canada, and more):** - We're structured to provide tax receipts - Same benefits as donating to big charities - But 100% of your donation creates impact --- ## 📊 Charity Overhead Comparison: The Numbers

These are approximate based on publicly available financial statements.* --- ## 🤔 FAQ: Direct Giving vs. Charity Organizations ### Q: But don't charities need overhead to operate? **A:** Some overhead is necessary for large organizations. But: - 5-10% overhead is reasonable - 15-40% overhead means your donation is funding the organization, not the cause - Direct giving eliminates unnecessary overhead entirely ### Q: How can AbleHearts have 0% overhead? **A:** - ✅ Volunteer-run (no salaries) - ✅ No physical offices (online only) - ✅ No marketing budget (word of mouth, social media) - ✅ Donations go directly to Mary & Lydia via PayPal, bank transfer, or M-PESA ### Q: Is direct giving sustainable? **A:** Yes! - Technology makes it possible (payment apps, social media, video calls) - Transparency builds trust (donors see real impact, give again) - Personal connection motivates ongoing support ### Q: What about big systemic issues that need large organizations? **A:** Fair point. Some problems (policy change, infrastructure) need big organizations. But for **individual human needs** (wheelchairs, medical care, food, education): - Direct giving is MORE effective - Faster impact - Lower cost - Higher transparency ### Q: How do I know AbleHearts is legitimate? **A:** - 📸 Real photos and videos of Mary & Lydia - 📝 Receipts for every purchase - 💬 Direct contact via [WhatsApp](https://wa.me/254107145882) - 🌐 Active social media ([Twitter](https://x.com/able_hearts_ke), Instagram, [TikTok](https://tiktok.com/@able_hearts), Facebook) - 📧 Email us: donations@able-hearts.org --- ## 💪 Join the Direct Giving Revolution ### The Choice Is Yours **Option A: Donate to Big Charity** - $100 donation - $15-40 goes to overhead - $60-85 (maybe) reaches someone in need - You never know who or see the impact **Option B: Donate to AbleHearts** - $100 donation - $0 overhead - $100 reaches Mary & Lydia - You see receipts, photos, updates - You know exactly who you helped **Which would you choose?** --- ## 🎯 Take Action: Donate Directly to Mary & Lydia Today **Every dollar you give provides:** - ♿ Wheelchairs for mobility - 🏥 Medical care for untreated wounds - 🍲 Nutritious food - 📚 Education for the orphan they care for - 🏠 Safe housing away from land-grabbing threats **Payment Options:** - 💙 PayPal: hesbonosoro1@gmail.com - 💳 Credit Card: Stripe checkout - 💰 Crypto: Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT - 📱 M-PESA: Direct to Kenya **100% of your donation. 0% overhead.
